title: Special Regulations for Accessory Non-residential Parking Facilities
previewText: The applicable district regulations pertaining to permitted or required off-street parking facilities accessory to non-residential uses shall apply to all developments on waterfront blocks except as modified in this Section or in Section 62-45.
